errors.evidence: The description claims the x-axis labels are for consecutive quarters, but the chart shows labels that skip several quarters (e.g., it jumps from 2003Q1 to 2004Q2).
The description claims the x-axis labels are rotated vertically, but they are oriented horizontally.
The description incorrectly identifies a peak around 2021Q3. The last significant peak before the end of the period occurs at 2020Q3, with a value slightly above 200.
